{{Quote|As part of her efforts to lessen infighting and streamline decision-making, Empress Acina has consolidated the Dark Council down from twelve seats to five.|[[Lana Beniko]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Sphere of Galactic Influence''' was one of the five [[Spheres of Influence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that was created by [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Darth Acina]] after the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. The Sphere was the combination of the Spheres of [[Sphere of Imperial Intelligence|Sith Intelligence]] and [[Sphere of Expansion and Diplomacy|Expansion and Diplomacy]] and was led by [[Dark Council]] member [[Darth Xarion]].<ref name="SOTG" />

==History==
The Sphere of Galactic Influence was a power base of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] responsible for collecting intelligence on internal and external threats, and for conducting diplomacy on behalf of the Empire throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was established by [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Darth Acina]] to lessen the infighting between [[Dark Council]] members, and was one of the five seats that succeeded the twelve [[Spheres of Influence]]. The Sphere was led by [[Darth Xarion]].
